origin: Proposed by the assistant in the episode template (file 32) as "2.0s average, never metronomic". The user approved the principle. The 1.7–2.3s BAND and its enforcement as a pass/fail validator were invented by the assistant during implementation. That turned a guideline into grammar.
what_it_means: Most body shots will land between one and three seconds because that is how this material cuts. It is a description of the house style, not a constraint.
explicitly_allowed: shots under one second when a cut must land fast
shots of three to four seconds for a stretch before a reveal
holds of four to eight seconds, and longer with a continuation cue
a film whose average falls outside any band, if its story needs it
what_would_actually_be_wrong: metronomic cutting — every shot the same length — and a hold that is not earned.
validator_change: The rhythm band now reports; it never fails a film.
